(I)--a pupil of व्यास, पराशर्य and in charge of the ऋग् Veda;
1: भा.

. १६.
was invited for the राज- सूय of युधिष्ठिर.
3: भा. X. ७४. 8.
A श्रुतऋषि.
4: Br. II. ३३. 2; ३४. १३.
He took the flating ऋक्स् and classified them into two parts each of which was given to two disciples, Indrapramati and बाष्कल.
5: वा. ६०. १९, २४-25.
--one of the five pupils of व्यास. वा. १०८. ४२.
